widgets_values: Use the provided start frame as an anchor of the point of view of the camera, no change is this regard occurs during the 10 second video. An extreme wide shot captures a man wearing a dark hoodie walking along an asphalt driveway toward a long, brown corrugated metal and brick wall, captured from a side view as the camera remains static. The lighting is overcast daylight, casting soft shadows across the textured brickwork and the gray pavement. Initially, the man approaches the base of the wall, his steps audible on the asphalt, and he stops directly in front of the wall. He pulls a silver spray paint can from inside his hoodie pocket, holding it steady, and begins slowly spraying large, bold letters onto the brick surface. The camera remains completely static, mimicking a fixed CCTV perspective, showing the entire process unfold in a continuous, unmoving frame as the man meticulously paints the letters sequentially across the wall, maintaining a slow, deliberate pace while the faint hiss of the spray can is audible against the ambient silence of the exterior setting.

## Model Links

**LTX-2.5 Model Weights**

Make sure to click the "Agree and Access" button the first time you download.

- [ Distilled model - ltx-2.5-22b-distilled-transformer-bf16.safetensors ](https://huggingface.co/Lightricks/LTX-2.5/blob/main/diffusion_models/ltx-2.5-22b-distilled-transformer-bf16.safetensors)

- [ Audio VAE - ltx-2.5-audio-vae-bf16.safetensors ](https://huggingface.co/Lightricks/LTX-2.5/blob/main/vae/ltx-2.5-audio-vae-bf16.safetensors)

```
│   │      └── gemma4_e2b_it_bf16.safetensors
│   ├── 📂 diffusion_models/
│   │      └── ltx-2.5-22b-distilled-transformer-bf16.safetensors
│   ├── 📂 vae/
│   │      └── ltx-2.5-audio-vae-bf16.safetensors
│   │      └── ltx-2.5-video-vae-conv-bf16.safetensors / ltx-2.5-video-vae-bf16.safetensors
```

widgets_values:
Rewrite a short security-incident title into a prompt for a video model.
Write in English only. 2-3 sentences, plain everyday language.
The video lasts about 10 seconds, in real time with no time jumps. Describe
only what fits in that time:
- Short actions (throwing, falling, grabbing): the person can arrive, act,
  and leave.
- Long actions (painting graffiti, prying a window, loitering): show only a
  part, e.g. the person arrives and starts, or is already there doing it.
  Do not make them finish or leave.
If the title already says how the event unfolds, keep that and don't add to it.
Do not describe the scene; the video model already sees it.
Always end with exactly: "The camera is a CCTV camera, no movement, tilt,
panning or zoom."

Example 1
Title: A person is breaking a window with a rock.
Prompt: A man comes down by the street and throws a rock at one window,
breaking the window and leaving crystals on the ground. The man starts running
and goes out of sight. The camera is a CCTV camera, no movement, tilt, panning
or zoom.

Example 2
Title: A man is spray-painting graffiti on the wall.
Prompt: A man in a hoodie walks up to the brick wall, takes out a spray can
and slowly starts painting large letters on it, continuing to paint until the
end. The camera is a CCTV camera, no movement, tilt, panning or zoom.

nodes.title: How to run this workflow
widgets_values:
## User Guide:

Load the snapshot taken from the Smart Client into the **Load Image** node.

Write one of the scenarios on the **Prompt** node.

Load your hardware compatible Qwen 3-VL weights into the **Load Clip** node.

Load your hardware compatible LTX model weights into the **Load LTX** node.

Run the workflow.
